maria (eng-platform): Heads-up: Console rollout on Monday will flip the new routing/telemetry header to default ON for hosted requests. We need a quick preflight for SDK behavior and opt-out UX.

oliver (devex): Wait, default ON? I thought we were doing opt-in by SDK to avoid breaking. What's the header name and semantics?

maria (eng-platform): Header: `x-redwood-routemeta-v2` — contains route id, sampling flag, and quota tag. If present, routing policies prefer it; if absent, server falls back to best-effort.

akshay (infra): Server fallback exists, but we saw a 0.4% increase in 5xxs in a canary when header received malformed JSON. SDKs must avoid sending empty/partial payloads.

tanya (sdk): Thanks — current TS/Go SDKs send a compact JSON object. Python has a legacy path that may send just a string tag for old users. We should enforce schema v2 from SDKs and add validation.

liz (product): From a UX POV we planned the console toggle as opt-out for org admins. We still want the telemetry benefits for routing/costing, but not at the expense of breaking customers.

maria (eng-platform): Proposal: ship console ON but gate SDKs behind a migration flag for 1 week. SDKs auto-validate payload and if invalid, strip header and emit a single telemetry warning log. Also surface a Console banner calling out the change.

oliver (devex): For the migration flag: can we expose an env var and also an explicit SDK config like `enableRoutingHeaders=true|false`? That lets customers quickly opt-out in legacy deployments.

tanya (sdk): We'll add `enableRoutingHeaders` (default false) to patch releases today for TS/Go/Py, and then flip default after 2 weeks. But note this is a semantic change — older pinned deps won't get default unless they upgrade. We need the console rollout to coordinate with a docs + release note.

akshay (infra): Can infra add a soft reject log message when header decode fails, with a sampling rate? We don't want noisy logs. Maybe 1% sampled errors to start.

maria (eng-platform): Yes, we'll add sampled logs. Also ask: do we want an observable metric `route_header_decode_failures` exported to Console dashboard? Product wants it on rollout tile.

liz (product): Please yes — show a small card on the rollout page. Also add an action button: "Disable SDK headers for org" (org-level opt-out) so support can flip quickly.

sdk-ci-bot: CI patch: created branch `sdk/routing-validate` for ts/go/py. Runs: unit + e2e header schema tests. https://ci.internal/runs/8821

tanya (sdk): I'll push TS changes today. Plan: validation logic -> if invalid, drop header + emit `redwood.sdk.route_header_invalid` counter with tags `{sdk:ts,version:x.y.z}`. Document fallback behavior in changelog.

oliver (devex): Add a quick migration guide snippet: `client.config({ enableRoutingHeaders: false })` and a note about older pinned versions. We should add a debug flag `REDWOOD_ROUTE_DEBUG=1` for verbose logs.

maria (eng-platform): Action items: 1) akshay: sampled server decode logs + metric. 2) tanya: SDK opt-in flag + validation + counter. 3) devex: migration doc + console banner + org opt-out button. 4) product: confirm rollout tile copy. Aim to coordinate toggle flip 2 weeks after SDK patch release.

liz (product): Confirmed. I'll prepare copy and a small playbook for support.

akshay (infra): Will add metric and a 1% sampled log stream to the infra dashboard.

maria (eng-platform): If no objections, I'm scheduling the console flip Mon 09:00 UTC. If we see decode failures >0.5% in first 24h, we roll back.

oliver (devex): +1. Can we do a 5% canary to start instead of global? Safer.

maria (eng-platform): Good call — change to 5% canary then ramp. I'll update rollout plan.

tanya (sdk): Pushing TS PR now. Will comment with release window.

maria (eng-platform): Thanks all — I'll update the rollout ticket and the console staging preview link once akshay's metric is wired.

liz (product): Thanks team! :rocket:
